zh-CN.Deck panels are large, so they drive the: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。
zh-CN.If the bed must move through doorways or: If the bed must move through doorways or fit in a small room, plan it as a knockdown frame with bolts or connector hardware instead of glue.
